title.en: Localize Ask AI input controls in all twelve languages
title.zh: 完整本地化十二语言 AI 输入控件

purpose.en: Remove the English fallback from the Ask AI composer placeholder and accessible input name while preserving learner-authored text exactly.
purpose.zh: 移除 AI 咨询输入框占位文案及无障碍名称的英文回退，同时完整保留学习者输入内容。

en: Provide reviewed composer labels for every SmartLingo interface language.
Keep the textarea value outside interface translation.
zh: 为 SmartLingo 每种界面语言提供已审核的输入控件文案。
输入框内容不参与界面翻译。

en: Ask AI composer placeholder and accessible input label in all twelve site languages
zh: 十二种网站语言下的 AI 咨询输入框占位文案及无障碍名称

en: Add a twelve-language assistant composer catalog.
Apply the active locale to dynamic textarea attributes without rewriting its value.
Add regression assertions for every supported placeholder.
zh: 新增十二语言 AI 输入控件目录。
将当前语言应用于动态文本框属性而不改写输入值。
为全部支持语言的占位文案新增回归断言。

en: Run route-language and assistant-input localization contracts plus the production build.
Use real Chrome on the Japanese Ask AI page, enter test text, and verify the exact value remains unchanged.
zh: 执行路由语言及 AI 输入本地化契约和生产构建。
使用真实 Chrome 打开日语 AI 咨询页，输入测试文字并确认内容保持完全不变。

en: Learner-authored course data remains displayed as authored; this release localizes the platform interface and built-in planner content.
zh: 学员自行创建的课程数据仍按原文显示；本次发布本地化平台界面与内置规划器内容。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's twelve target-language courses, five-skill learning model, anonymous trial, SmartCards, Sprint, and reward-point isolation.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 十二目标语言课程、五项技能学习模式、匿名试学、智慧卡、速成及积分隔离。
